heading: Plan your stay.
subhead: We answer every inquiry personally — usually within the same day. Call, email, or send us a note and we'll help you find the right cottage.
bookingInstructions: For the fastest answer, call us. For dates further out, email is fine — please include the dates you're considering and how many adults and children will be coming.
formNote: Or send a quick note — we'll get back to you with availability.
